description:
Use this when the user wants the video file of a clip, or to open it in the full editor: "send me the clip",
        "download it", "I want to post it myself", "let me edit this one". Returns download_url, a private link that
        works for five minutes (call again for a fresh one; keep it private), and editor_url, which opens the clip in
        RipClip's editor to change the cut, captions, framing, effects or music. clip_id comes from list_clips or a
        finished job; for a saved photo the link gives the picture.
        Not for: watching clips in the chat (show_clips), a still picture of one moment (preview_frame), or posting it
        (draft_post). Free; it only makes a short-lived link and changes nothing in the account.
name: get_download_link
title: Get download link
